The lexicon-based sentiment features provide meaningful predictive leverage beyond the raw text, but sparsity in several counts (e.g., intensified_neg_count and negation_before_pos_count are mostly zero) and reliance on some generic features limit the overall lift, yielding moderate predictive utility."
}
